textbookBox.concept: Boxes, cans, bottles and cones are solid shapes. The box is a cube, the can and bottle are cylinders, a funnel is a cone and a book-like box is a cuboid.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Boxes, cans, bottles and cones are solid shapes. The box is a cube, the can and bottle are cylinders, a funnel is a cone and a book-like box is a cuboid. A cube is a special cuboid in which all faces are squares.
beats.speakEn: Boxes, cans, bottles and cones are solid shapes. The box is a cube, the can and bottle are cylinders, a funnel is a cone and a book-like box is a cuboid. A cube is a special cuboid in which all faces are squares.

beats.en: Some shapes have straight edges and flat faces, like a cube and a cuboid. Some shapes have curved parts, like a cylinder, a cone and a ball. A cylinder has curved sides, and a cone has a curved side and a pointed top.
beats.speakEn: Some shapes have straight edges and flat faces, like a cube and a cuboid. Some shapes have curved parts, like a cylinder, a cone and a ball. A cylinder has curved sides, and a cone has a curved side and a pointed top.
